c2-gen-0027: On the fourth day God set lights in the sky. Read Genesis 1:14.
c2-gen-0028: Adam gave names to the cattle and the birds. Look at Genesis 2:11 and 20.
c3-gen-0018: God split light from dark. We meet the first family. See Genesis 1:4 and 3:20.
c3-isa-0017: God hears His people and talks about their future. Read Isaiah 65:23 and 24.
c3-gen-0019: Adam speaks about the woman God made. Look at Genesis 2:23 and 3:12.
c3-gen-0020: God set the lights, and the making was done. See Genesis 1:17 and 2:1.
c3-gen-0021: God made man, and later spoke to the woman. Check Genesis 1:27 and 3:16.
c3-gen-0022: A man is joined to his wife. Later he ate. See Genesis 2:24 and 3:12.
c3-rev-0006: John sees the city measured, and the nations coming in. See Revelation 21:15 and 26.
c3-rev-0007: Nothing unclean comes into that city. Read Revelation 21:27 and 22:3.
c2-mrk-0010: Jesus came to Galilee preaching after John was held. Peek at Mark 1:15.
c2-dan-0009: Daniel tells the king about a great image. See Daniel 2:31 and 37.
c3-dan-0007: Daniel starts to tell the meaning of the dream. Check Daniel 2:36 and 42.
c3-psa-0014: One generation tells the next about God's works. Read Psalm 145:3 and 4.
c3-mat-0012: Crowds gathered, and His friends asked about the stories. Look at Matthew 13:2 and 10.
c3-dan-0008: Daniel finishes the dream. A psalm praises the King. See Daniel 2:45 and Psalm 145:1.
c3-dan-0009: John was held. Daniel spoke to a king. See Daniel 2:38 and Mark 1:14.
c3-mat-0013: One kingdom crushes the others. Jesus tells a story. See Matthew 13:47 and Daniel 2:40.
c3-psa-0015: A later kingdom follows. The psalm praises God's rule. See Psalm 145:13 and Daniel 2:39.
c3-mat-0014: Jesus spoke to crowds. A psalm ends in praise. See Matthew 13:34 and Psalm 145:21.
c2-ezk-0014: The LORD promises to bring His people home. Peek at Ezekiel 36:24.
c2-jhn-0022: Jesus goes to the Father and has more to say. See John 16:10 and 12.
c3-jhn-0011: Jesus says He is telling them the truth. Check John 16:7 and 9.
c3-act-0007: Peter points back to Joel on that special day. Turn to Acts 2:1 and 16.
c3-rom-0015: Paul talks about waiting for what we do not see. Read Romans 8:24 and 25.
c3-jhn-0012: The Father will send the Helper, who will honor Jesus. See John 14:16 and 16:14.
c3-act-0008: They all saw the risen Jesus. The crowd was amazed. See Acts 2:7 and 32.
c3-act-0009: They had favor with the people. God raised Jesus. Check Acts 2:24 and 47.
c3-rom-0016: Paul talks of creation and of life in the flesh. See Romans 8:8 and 20.
c3-gal-0003: Paul says not to get puffed up. Read Galatians 5:17 and 26.
c2-deu-0016: God promised a prophet like Moses. I listen close now. Peek at Deuteronomy 18:18.
c2-exo-0023: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Egypt. See Exodus 12:1 and 2.
c3-lev-0005: Aaron gets ready, then comes to the tabernacle door. Check Leviticus 16:4 and 7.
c3-exo-0008: They kept the lamb, and a neighbor could be included. See Exodus 12:4 and 6.
c3-heb-0010: Priests kept going into the first part of the tabernacle. See Hebrews 9:1 and 6.
c3-lev-0006: That day is called a sabbath of rest. Read Leviticus 16:20 and 31.
c3-lev-0007: The anointed priest is set apart for this work. See Leviticus 16:14 and 32.
c3-gen-0023: Abraham reached the place, and the LORD spoke. Check Genesis 22:10 and 16.
c3-heb-0011: The high priest went in alone, only once a year. See Hebrews 9:3 and 7.
c3-heb-0012: Hebrews talks about old washings and old rules. Look at Hebrews 9:5 and 10.
c2-psa-0024: Some people made fun of the speaker. Peek at Psalm 22:7.
c2-isa-0025: Who believed the report? Isaiah then speaks of the Servant. See Isaiah 53:1 and 4.
c3-psa-0016: He asks God not to be far. Trouble is near. See Psalm 22:1 and 11.
c3-isa-0018: The Servant will make many right with God. Look at Isaiah 53:8 and 11.
c3-jhn-0013: Soldiers took His clothes and later offered Him a drink. Check John 19:23 and 29.
c3-psa-0017: Another writing says people would look at Him. See Psalm 22:16 and John 19:37.
c3-jhn-0014: Jesus carried all our wrongs for us. Read John 19:33 and Isaiah 53:6.
c3-psa-0018: Isaiah says the Servant will make many right. Look at Psalm 22:6 and Isaiah 53:11.
c3-mic-0009: Our fathers trusted in God. Micah looks ahead too. See Micah 5:5 and Psalm 22:4.
c3-mat-0015: Herod gathered the priests. Isaiah asks about a report. See Matthew 2:4 and Isaiah 53:1.
c2-isa-0026: Isaiah opens with a call to the city. Peek at Isaiah 60:1.
c2-isa-0027: A foreigner has joined himself to the LORD. See Isaiah 56:3 and 5.
c3-isa-0020: God will answer their cry. He talks about true fasting. See Isaiah 58:6 and 9.
c3-isa-0021: God called to a nation that never looked for Him. See Isaiah 65:1 and 5.
c3-isa-0022: Servants sing for joy. The LORD then mentions the earth. See Isaiah 65:14 and 66:1.
c3-isa-0023: God says to keep justice and do what is right. Read Isaiah 56:1 and 58:10.
c3-isa-0024: Some keep His Sabbaths. Violence will leave the land. See Isaiah 56:4 and 60:18.
c3-isa-0025: Delight yourself in the LORD. He looks on the humble. See Isaiah 58:14 and 66:2.
c3-isa-0026: Isaiah talks about what will last before the LORD. Turn to Isaiah 60:11 and 66:22.
c3-isa-0027: Isaiah talks about a birth that comes quickly. Look at Isaiah 65:10 and 66:7.
c2-ezk-0015: Ezekiel is taken to a gateway and sees a man. Peek at Ezekiel 40:3.
c2-ezk-0016: Look, listen, and fix your mind on what is shown. See Ezekiel 40:1 and 4.
c3-ezk-0009: The temple's law is given so people may feel shame. See Ezekiel 43:10 and 12.
c3-ezk-0010: Priests put on linen in the inner court. Turn to Ezekiel 44:1 and 17.
c3-ezk-0011: The north side is measured, and tribes get the land. See Ezekiel 47:14 and 48:30.
c3-ezk-0012: Set on a high mountain, he is shown the temple. See Ezekiel 40:2 and 43:11.
c3-ezk-0013: A voice spoke from the temple. Priests get linen clothes. See Ezekiel 43:6 and 44:18.
c3-ezk-0014: A district is set apart. Priests must teach the people. See Ezekiel 44:23 and 48:8.
c3-ezk-0015: The land is divided among the tribes of Israel. Turn to Ezekiel 47:21 and 48:35.
c3-ezk-0016: Ezekiel was brought toward the east. Look at Ezekiel 43:1 and 48:31.
